raw_problem.problem_text:
(a) 构造关于 $\sigma _ { A } \sigma _ { B }$ 的不确定性原理.

(b) 对于氢原子态 $\psi _ { n \ell m }$ ，计算 $\sigma _ { B }$   
(c) 在该态下，关于 $\langle x y \rangle$ 你能得到什么结论?
raw_problem.solution_text:
时由方程 (3.62)

$$
\sigma_ {A} ^ {2} \sigma_ {B} ^ {2} \geqslant \left(\frac {1}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left\langle [ \hat {A}, \hat {B} ] \right\rangle\right) ^ {2}
$$

及 $x ^ { 2 }$ 与 $L _ { z }$ 的对易关系

$$
\left[ x ^ {2}, L _ {z} \right] = x \left[ x, L _ {z} \right] + \left[ x, L _ {z} \right] x,
$$

其中

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ x, L _ {z} ] = [ x, x p _ {y} - y p _ {x} ] = [ x, x p _ {y} ] - [ x, y p _ {x} ] \\ = - [ x p _ {y}, x ] + [ y p _ {x}, x ] \\ = - x [ p _ {y}, x ] - [ x, x ] p _ {y} + y [ p _ {x}, x ] + [ p _ {x}, x ] y \\ = y (- \mathrm {i} \hbar) + (- \mathrm {i} \hbar) y \\ = - 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar y, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以，

$$
\left[ x ^ {2}, L _ {z} \right] = - 2 \mathrm {i} \hbar x y.
$$

故

$$
\sigma_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {2} \sigma_ {L _ {z}} ^ {2} \geqslant \left(\frac {1}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left\langle [ x ^ {2}, L _ {z} ] \right\rangle\right) ^ {2} = (\hbar \langle x y \rangle) ^ {2} \Rightarrow \sigma_ {x ^ {2}} \sigma_ {L _ {z}} \geqslant \hbar | \langle x y \rangle |.
$$

$( \mathrm { b } ) \psi _ { n \ell m }$ 是 $L _ { z }$ 的本征态，本征值为 mñ 所以

$$
\left\langle L _ {z} \right\rangle = \left\langle \psi_ {n \ell m} \right| L _ {z} \left| \psi_ {n \ell m} \right\rangle = m \hbar ,
$$

$$
\left\langle L _ {z} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle \psi_ {n \ell m} \right| L _ {z} ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {n \ell m} \right\rangle = m ^ {2} \hbar^ {2},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {L _ {z}} = \sqrt {\left\langle L _ {z} ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle L _ {z} \right\rangle^ {2}} = \sqrt {m ^ {2} \hbar^ {2} - (m \hbar) ^ {2}} = 0.
$$

(c) 由于对 $\psi _ { n \ell m }$ 态， $\sigma _ { L _ { z } } = 0$ , (a) 中得出的不确定关系左边为零，这样为使不确定关系成立，右边也必须为零，所以 $\langle x y \rangle = 0$ .
